spec.kitLine: Deals 52.36% of final ATK as damage
spec.assertion: Repeated skill-bucket hits, count > 1 but < shot count → excludes both a one-shot cast-time hit and a per-shot rider. FB-by-timing asserted (some hit has fbMajorApplied) → fails the nearest-wrong noFb:true model. Zeroing atkPct lowers only novel; every teammate byte-identical.

buffApply with stat defPct and casterIdx===null && targetIdx===null (boss-held), |value|≈7.05, expiresFrame−frame ≤ 5×60. Removing it LOWERS at least one teammate → discriminates a real boss DEF debuff from the nearest-wrong self/ally-scoped defPct buff (under which teammates would be byte-identical).

First Cornucopia buffApply frame ≥ the 100th shot's frame → a passive/interval/burstCast trigger (all of which can fire before 100 hits) fails. Non-vacuity pre-check asserts novel actually fires >100 shots in the fixture.

targetSlug==='novel', value≈13.5, maxStacks===5, window ≤ 15×60, stacks never exceed 5. Then the inertness assertion: scaling the value 13.5→135 moves NO unit's total by any amount → fails immediately if the line was mis-encoded as an ATK/attackDamagePct buff to fit a number (measured>fudge).

Count of burst-bucket damage events === count of novel's OWN burstCast events → a fullBurstEnter keying (which fires on any team Full Burst) over-fires and fails. All burst hits have fbMajorApplied falsy → pins the verified 'burst-cast lands before Full Burst begins' fact. Zeroing moves only novel.

buffApply stat damageTakenPct, value≈67.5, casterIdx===null && targetIdx===null; removing it lowers at least one TEAMMATE → discriminates the boss debuff from the nearest-wrong self-buff reading (taxonomy item 4). Window ≤ 5×60 frames pins the duration against a permanent encoding.

Every damageTakenPct apply frame ≥ the frame Cornucopia first reaches 5 stacks, PLUS a non-vacuity test proving at least one burst cast occurs BEFORE that frame (500 landed normals are needed for max stacks, so early bursts exist). Together they fail the nearest-wrong UNGATED model, which fires the team-wide 67.5% on every cast. A third assertion removes the gate and requires team damage to strictly INCREASE, proving the gate is load-bearing rather than decorative.

it.skip — same single-enemy reason; the ranking is a no-op at scope lock.

it.skip — the firing PERIOD is not in the kit text's input domain (ALWAYS-⚑ field 2: a damage line with no stated trigger). Interval convention + datamined cd 20s is the estimate; asserting an exact hit count would launder a ⚑ estimate into a measured pin. Recipe recorded: count 52.36% popups in a scope-lock recording, derive the period, then assert the exact count.

fixtures: controlComp('novel', true) only — one comp, deterministic, no seed. novel is Burst II, so the control's B1/B2/fixed-B3 slots complete a real chain and Full Bursts actually occur (a lone unit would make ZERO full bursts and every FB-timing and burst-cast assertion would be vacuous). The fixed B3 is kept because novel grants no ATK/crit stat that the helm slot's buffs could confound — novel's whole output is self damage plus two BOSS-side debuffs, both of which are read off buffApply events (casterIdx/targetIdx null) rather than off totals, and the teammate-movement assertions only need SOME ally to move, which a larger buffed team makes more robust. All runs hoisted: one base run reused across every read-only assertion, plus 6 counterfactual runs = 7 total, well under the ~20-run budget.
gaps: skill1 'Affects 3 enemy unit(s) with the highest final DEF' — it.skip: single partless boss at scope lock; no enemy entity in the sim, so multi-target selection and final-DEF ranking are unobservable.
burst 'Affects the 1 enemy unit(s) with the highest final ATK' — it.skip: same single-enemy reason; the ranking is a no-op.

skill1 52.36% cadence — it.skip (⚑): the kit gives NO activation clause, so the interval period is outside the input domain. Datamined cd 20s + first-fire-at-t=sec is a convention, not a measurement; pinning an exact hit count would encode the estimate as truth. Recipe to close is in the skip body.

NOT a gap but flagged: novel's SMG cadence tuple (pullsPerSec) is a datamine-unreliable ALWAYS-⚑ field; no assertion in this file depends on the exact shots-per-second, only on 'more than 100 shots happen', which is robust across the plausible range.
